summary.headline: The committee unanimously rejected spending $30,000 on a wastewater financial study, choosing to verify site feasibility first.
summary.summary: The Wastewater Study Committee evaluated preliminary site screening analyses and determined that spending $30,000 on a District Improvement Financing (DIF) financial study by Camoin Associates would be premature. A technical review raised questions regarding Sudbury Reservoir watershed restrictions that could eliminate potential treatment locations, including properties north and south of Route 9. The committee voted 0-5 against funding the Camoin study, choosing instead to focus resources on identifying a viable site and consulting with state environmental regulators.

topics.title: Site selection review and Camoin DIF study funding
topics.summary: The committee reviewed desktop site analyses conducted by consulting firm Artifacts and committee members, which examined locations such as 532 Turnpike Road. Members discussed regulatory restrictions associated with Sudbury Reservoir watershed zones and concluded it is premature to spend $30,000 on a Camoin Associates economic development study before knowing whether a feasible wastewater site exists. The committee voted unanimously against funding the Camoin study, effectively postponing a planned DIF article for Fall Town Meeting.
key_details: Artifacts initially identified 532 Turnpike Road as a potential location, but watershed restrictions complicate parcel availability.
Sudbury Reservoir watershed rules include three protection zones with varying degrees of development restrictions.
The proposed Camoin study would have cost $30,000 to prepare financial modeling for a District Improvement Financing district.
Members agreed a Fall Town Meeting DIF article would likely fail without a confirmed treatment site.
The committee plans to consult with the Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection in Worcester and explore potential regional cooperation with Westborough.
topics.why_it_matters: Halts a planned $30,000 financial consulting contract and pauses efforts to place a wastewater financing article on the Fall Town Meeting warrant until an allowable site can be secured.

votes.motion: Support $30,000 to conduct the Camoin study

upcoming.what: Follow up with MassDEP in Worcester regarding watershed zone restrictions and consult with MassDevelopment and Camoin
